prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live web access, so I can’t look up current ratings. If you want a specific “best” salon right now I can either (A) help you search on Google/Yelp by giving exact search terms and what to look for, or (B) evaluate 2–3 salon names/links you paste here and tell you which looks best.

Before that, quick questions so my recommendations match what you want:
- Do you want UV tanning (beds) or spray tans?
- Which part of Pleasanton or what ZIP code is most convenient?
- Any budget or membership preference?

How to pick the best tanning salon (short checklist)
1. Read recent reviews (Google/Yelp/Facebook) — look at reviews from the last 6 months for cleanliness and service consistency.  
2. Ask about tanning options — high-pressure (faster, less frequent) vs low-pressure beds, stand-up vs lay-down, and spray options/brands (Norvell, VersaSpa, etc.).  
3. Safety & staff training — staff should offer a patch test for spray, explain recommended exposure times, and have visible training/certifications.  
4. Cleanliness — premises, beds, and spray booths should be well maintained; staff should provide disposable eye protection.  
5. Equipment quality & maintenance — newer/or well-maintained beds with clear time/settings.  
6. Pricing & packages — check single sessions, package discounts, membership fine print, cancellation policies.  
7. Products & aftercare — lotions, accelerators, and recommended aftercare should be available.  
8. Trial visit — go see the salon: check lighting, smell, staff friendliness, and ask to view the bed/booth before booking.

Questions to ask a salon when you call or visit
- What brands/types of beds or spray systems do you use?
- Do you require/offer a patch test for spray tans?
- How are beds sanitized between clients?
- What are your exposure time recommendations and max sessions per week?
- Do you offer memberships/packages and what are the cancellation terms?
- Do you provide protective eyewear and disposable liners?

If you want, tell me your preferences or paste 2–3 salon names you’re deciding between and I’ll help pick the best one based on reviews/amenities guidelines.
